summary: HypoExplorer estimates the 27-month versus 6-month expression difference across all 12 collection times in male mouse hypothalamus. The authors included 18-month mice and fitted a separate age trend in each of four circadian windows. Even the 604 genes in the “all” list have four window-specific slopes per gene. The registered endpoint therefore remains unassessed. The proposal and 57 retained public responses passed integrity checks. [Author Table S3](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC9929559.1/NIHMS1870531-supplement-6.xlsx)
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release gene-level effects for the 24 endpoint libraries with a common age contrast adjusted for collection time.
The original preprint supplementary files could not be independently retrieved. The review covered all 22 preprint table legends and the complete final publication supplement set.
